notes: Ludum Dare 42 (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/42/box-o-matic-4000) by Kassanu. Complete Unity 2018.2.3f1 factory game with playable title and main scenes in EditorBuildSettings. GPL-3.0 at the repo-root LICENSE. Official Unity packages only (TextMesh Pro 1.2.4 is a package dependency; no TMP assets vendored under Assets/). No bundled fonts, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ProjectVersion.txt retained.
